subject: English
question_text: Use capitals and punctuation marks where necessary in the following text.
stimulus: Porter you may go said the mistress of the house laughing you have gained your freedom by Allah he replied “I wont leave the house until ive heard the stories of my companions.” Part−B : Composition [40 Marks]
guide_solution: Capitalization and punctuation "Porter, you may go," said the mistress of the house laughing. "You have gained your freedom." "By Allah," he replied, "I won't leave the house until I've heard the stories of my companions." Part−B : Composition See SSC English Made Easy To Test Papers Book
